title: Actual CPU PPO updates on a finite contextual policy
outcome: Train a tiny categorical policy with the PPO surrogate and critic loss while testing frozen rollout state, optimization and independent task utility.

exercises.title: Trace the expectation weights
exercises.task: Sum old-policy weights across both contexts and actions.
exercises.answer: An unweighted average over actions would cease to represent the old-policy expectation once the policy becomes nonuniform.

exercises.title: Inspect frozen state
exercises.task: Compare the old probability tensor before and after each inner update.
exercises.hint: Detach and copy the collector snapshot.
exercises.answer: Current-policy updates must not move the denominator of their own importance ratio.

exercises.title: Separate critic and actor gradients
exercises.task: Explain why the advantage uses detached values.
exercises.expected: The actor cannot improve its objective by changing its baseline through that path.
exercises.hint: The critic is trained by a separate squared-error term.
exercises.answer: Without this graph boundary the implemented gradient would contain an unintended optimization route.

exercises.title: Check symmetry
exercises.task: Swap the two contexts and their useful actions.
exercises.expected: The learned probability rows mirror each other.
exercises.hint: Both start from the same logits and use symmetric rewards.
exercises.answer: This invariant tests the small environment and update implementation independently of a particular random seed.

exercises.title: Optimize a bad proxy
exercises.task: Run case B and evaluate the resulting policy under the original task utility.
exercises.expected: Training reward exceeds 0.9 while task utility is below 0.1.
exercises.hint: Keep the evaluation utility outside the optimizer.
exercises.answer: Correct execution of PPO cannot validate a mistaken or exploitable reward definition.

exercises.title: State the scale boundary
exercises.task: List what this actual training run omits from an LLM deployment.
exercises.expected: Tokenization, sampled language rollouts, long-horizon credit, pretrained weights and serving are absent.
exercises.answer: The run establishes a small CPU optimization mechanism, not a production language model or a guarantee of safe alignment.
